This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation. Summary: 1. Primary Request and Intent: The user wants to add multi-dimensional componentisation to a conversation context viewer app. Currently each conversation segment maps to one component. The user wants: - Multiple "dimensions" per segment, each with its own name, prompt, and component mapping - Default dimension named "default" - Each dimension gets its own LLM pipeline (identify → map → color) - Editing a prompt should rerun only that dimension's pipeline - Dimension management UI (add/remove/rename/edit prompt) in the sidebar workflow detail modal popup, under the "Find components" step - In the Components tab: just dimension checkboxes, a single blended waffle chart (not separate per-dimension), with a multi-column legend showing token counts and percentages per dimension - Component filter in conversations view should show components from ALL dimensions, not just default - Color blending when viewing multiple dimensions (RGB averaging) - Renaming "default" should actually rename it, not create a new dimension 2. Key Technical Concepts: - `DimensionData` interface: `{ name, prompt, components, componentMapping, componentTimeline, componentColors, customComponents, customColoringPrompt }` - Parallel dimension processing via `Promise.all` in activities - `targetDimension` field on WorkflowState for selective reprocessing - Legacy field sync: `components`, `componentMapping`, `componentTimeline`, `componentColors` mirror the "default" dimension for backward compatibility - Color blending via RGB averaging (`blendColors`) - React state: `activeDimensions: Set` tracks which dimensions are being viewed - Workflow events: `ComponentPromptChanged` with `targetDimension` set reruns only one dimension 3. Files and Code Sections: - **`src/componentisation.ts`** - Core data model. Added `DimensionData` interface. - ```typescript export interface DimensionData { name: string; prompt?: string; components: string[]; componentMapping: Record; componentTimeline: ComponentTimelineSnapshot[]; componentColors: Record; customComponents?: string[]; customColoringPrompt?: string; } ``` - **`src/lib/component-colors.ts`** - Added `blendColors()` and `getBlendedColorForPart()` utilities. - ```typescript export function blendColors(hexColors: string[]): string { if (hexColors.length === 0) return colorNameToWaffleHex.gray!; if (hexColors.length === 1) return hexColors[0]!; const rgbs = hexColors.map(hexToRgb); const avg = { r: Math.round(rgbs.reduce((s, c) => s + c.r, 0) / rgbs.length), g: Math.round(rgbs.reduce((s, c) => s + c.g, 0) / rgbs.length), b: Math.round(rgbs.reduce((s, c) => s + c.b, 0) / rgbs.length), }; return rgbToHex(avg.r, avg.g, avg.b); } ``` - **`src/App.tsx`** (3100+ lines, central state management) - Added `dimensions` and `targetDimension` to `WorkflowState` - Added dimension helpers before Main Workflow section: - `syncLegacyFieldsFromDimensions(ctx)` - syncs legacy fields from default dimension - `ensureDimensions(ctx)` - ensures dimensions dict exists, migrates legacy fields - `getDimensionNames(ctx)` - returns dimension names - Updated `findComponentsActivity` to return `{ components, mapping, timeline, dimensions, error }` and process per `targetDimension` or all dimensions in parallel - Updated `assignColorsActivity` similarly - Added all `ctx.dimensions = result.dimensions` assignments in workflow - Added `dimensions` to all WorkflowRunner state propagation methods (startStep, updateState, markComplete) - Added state: `activeDimensions`, `editingDimensionName` - Added handlers: `handleAddDimension`, `handleRemoveDimension`, `handleRenameDimension`, `handleEditDimensionPrompt`, `handleApplyDimensionPrompt` - Updated `handleOpenPromptEditor` to accept optional `dimensionName` parameter - Updated `handleApplyPrompt` to call `handleApplyDimensionPrompt` - Passes `dimensions`, `activeDimensions`, dimension callbacks to ConversationView and ConversationList - Passes `onAddDimension`, `onRemoveDimension`, `onRenameDimension`, `onEditDimensionPrompt` to ConversationList - **`src/components/WorkflowDetailModal.tsx`** - Added dimension accordion inside "Find components" CollapsibleContent - Added props: `dimensions`, `onAddDimension`, `onRemoveDimension`, `onRenameDimension`, `onEditDimensionPrompt` - Added local state: `expandedDimension`, `addingDimension`, `newDimensionName`, `renamingDimension`, `renameValue` - Accordion shows dimension list with component counts, expand to see components with color swatches, edit/rename/delete actions - **`src/components/ConversationList.tsx`** - Added `dimensions` to local WorkflowState interface - Added dimension management callbacks to props and destructuring - Added dimension accordion in the inline step view (below "Find components" step) - Added same local state for dimension accordion management - Passes dimension props to WorkflowDetailModal - Fixed duplicate `cn` import - **`src/components/ComponentsView.tsx`** - Removed large dimension management accordion (moved to modal) - Now has simple checkbox selector for dimensions - Still has per-dimension waffle charts code (needs to be changed to single blended chart per user feedback) - Uses `effectiveMapping` and `effectiveColors` derived from active dimensions - Has `getWaffleStylesForDimensions()` helper for blended colors - **`src/components/ConversationView.tsx`** - Added props: `dimensions`, `activeDimensions`, `onActiveDimensionsChange`, `onAddDimension`, `onRemoveDimension`, `onRenameDimension`, `onEditDimensionPrompt` - Passes `dimensions`, `activeDimensions`, `onActiveDimensionsChange` to ComponentsView - Passes `dimensions`, `activeDimensions` to MessageView - **`src/components/MessagePartView.tsx`** - Added `dimensions` and `activeDimensions` props - Shows multiple dimension badges when multiple dimensions active (format: "dimName: componentName") - **`src/components/MessageView.tsx`** - Added `dimensions` and `activeDimensions` props, passes to MessagePartView - **`src/components/ComponentComparisonView.tsx`** - Extended `ConversationComponentData` with optional `dimensionData` field 4. Errors and fixes: - **Duplicate `cn` import in ConversationList.tsx**: My new imports at the top added `cn` but it was already imported lower down. Fixed by removing the duplicate. - **Pre-existing TypeScript errors**: App.tsx had 5 pre-existing TS errors (unrelated to my changes) that I verified by stashing and checking. - **User feedback: accordion in wrong place**: I initially put the dimension management accordion in the ComponentsView tab. User clarified it should be in the WorkflowDetailModal popup (the workflow steps modal). Moved it. - **User feedback: separate waffle charts**: I implemented per-dimension waffle charts stacked vertically. User wants a single blended waffle chart instead with multi-column legend. NOT YET FIXED. - **User feedback: rename "default" creates new dimension**: The `handleRenameDimension` handler renames the key in the dimensions dict, but `syncLegacyFieldsFromDimensions` and `ensureDimensions` both hardcode `"default"` key. NOT YET FIXED. - **User feedback: component filter only shows default dimension**: The conversation view's component filter only uses `components` from the legacy field (default dimension). NOT YET FIXED. 5. Problem Solving: - Successfully implemented the multi-dimensional data model with backward compatibility - Per-dimension parallel LLM processing works - Dimension management UI (add/remove/rename/edit) in the workflow modal works - Two commits made: `fbb0d70` (first cut) and `3ffe571` (move accordion to modal) - Remaining issues from user feedback need to be addressed 6. All user messages: - **Message 1**: Detailed feature request for multi-dimensional componentisation covering data model, LLM calls, and UI requirements. Key points: dimensions with names/prompts, per-dimension LLM calls, accordion in sidebar for managing dimensions, dimension selector in component views, color blending, multi-column legend in comparison view. - **Message 2**: "commit what we have so far as a first cut. there's many things to fix." - **Message 3**: "i meant adding an accordion for managing dimensions in this popup modal, in the find components section, not the main components tab." (with screenshot of WorkflowDetailModal) - **Message 4** (system-reminder while working): Multiple feedback items: - Don't want waffles one below other - want blended colors in single waffle chart - Legend should have token counts and percentage (twin columns) per dimension - Components tab should just have checkbox for choosing dimensions - Want to filter by components of any dimension, not only default - Renaming default should change the name, not create another dimension 7. Pending Tasks: - Replace per-dimension waffle charts with single blended waffle chart - Add multi-column legend with token counts/percentages per dimension - Fix component filter to show components from all dimensions (not just default) - Fix rename "default" dimension bug (currently creates new instead of renaming) - The dimension helpers (`ensureDimensions`, `syncLegacyFieldsFromDimensions`) hardcode "default" and need to handle renamed defaults 8. Current Work: I had just committed the second change (moving accordion to modal) and was about to address the user's follow-up feedback (message 4). I had read the current state of ComponentsView.tsx lines 220-300 which still has the per-dimension waffle charts code that needs to be replaced with a single blended chart. The user then requested this summary. The specific code in ComponentsView.tsx that needs changing (lines 245-283) shows per-dimension waffle charts: ```tsx {/* Per-dimension waffle charts when multiple active */} {hasMultipleDimensions && activeDimensions.size > 1 ? (
{[...activeDimensions].map((dimName) => { // ... renders separate WaffleChart per dimension })}
) : ( ``` This needs to become a single blended waffle chart with a multi-column legend. 9. Optional Next Step: Address the user's feedback from message 4. The most immediate changes needed: 1. **Single blended waffle chart**: Replace the per-dimension waffle chart loop in ComponentsView with a single chart that blends colors across active dimensions, and add a multi-column legend showing per-dimension token counts and percentages. 2. **Fix rename default**: Update `handleRenameDimension` in App.tsx and the dimension helpers to properly handle renaming "default" (track which dimension name maps to the legacy fields). 3. **Fix component filter**: Update ConversationView.tsx to collect components from all dimensions (not just `components` prop which is the default dimension) for the filter dropdown. User's exact words: "I don't want the waffles to appear one below the other in the components tab. I want the colors to blend in a single waffle chart. And I want the legend of the waffle chart to have token counts and percentage (twin columns), per dimension."
